Riverside Diagnostics Laboratory Complete Blood Count and Metabolic Panel Report. Patient sample collected after an eight hour fast. Haemoglobin 10.9 grams per decilitre, below the reference range of 13.5 to 17.5, consistent with mild anaemia. Mean corpuscular volume 72 femtolitres, low, suggesting microcytic red blood cells often associated with iron deficiency. Serum ferritin 9 nanograms per millilitre, low. White blood cell count 7.2 thousand per microlitre, within normal limits. Platelet count 265 thousand per microlitre, normal. Fasting glucose 118 milligrams per decilitre, above the normal range and in the prediabetes range. HbA1c 6.1 percent. LDL cholesterol 162 milligrams per decilitre, elevated. Pathologist comment: findings suggest iron deficiency anaemia and impaired fasting glucose; clinical correlation and follow up with the treating physician is recommended.
